headline: Bosch Global Software Technologies exercises over-subscription option in Bosch Home Comfort India Limited OFS
sum: Bosch Global Software Technologies Private Limited (a Bosch subsidiary) has exercised its over-subscription option to acquire an additional 2,02,634 equity shares in Bosch Home Comfort India Limited via an offer for sale (OFS) mechanism on the NSE.
detail: Bosch Global Software Technologies Private Limited, holding a stake in Bosch Home Comfort India Limited (BHCIL), notified the NSE of its intention to exercise a contractual over-subscription option covering 2,02,634 equity shares. The over-subscription feature permits the seller to increase the offer quantum beyond the base tranche if investor demand exceeds the initial offering size. This intimation was filed as a regulatory obligation under the exchange's OFS rules and stock exchange listing regulations.
